note: The lookup warns that the electrode name was renamed, then retries the lookup with 'particle' replaced by 'electrode'.
The rename branch copies the legacy value into the new key and returns the mapping with the legacy entry still present.
When check_already_exists is enabled, the update looks up each incoming name in _dict_items and raises if the lookup fails.
The FuzzyDict test expects a DeprecationWarning and equal values for the positive electrode and particle diffusivity lookups.
